title: H16 pull-request render output
description: The one JSON line pull-request render prints, whose title and body the create_pull_request call passes unchanged.

title.description: type(scope): summary, at most 72 characters, lowercase summary, no trailing period (PR_TITLE_PATTERN).

body.description: Problem, Change (bullets, then the approach paragraph), Impact, optional Trade-offs and open problems, Testing table, optional Links, optional folded Receipts block, sections one blank line apart.
